load_antennae_fits_images: load raw Antennae galaxy FITS images from a directory and resize them to 60x60 tensors
preprocess_antennae_images: preprocess Antennae galaxy images by rotating, clipping, normalizing, and re-normalizing pixel values
normalize_antennae_with_asinh: apply inverse hyperbolic sine normalization to galaxy image pixel values with a configurable scale factor
renormalize_antennae_by_median: re-normalize galaxy images by subtracting the median and dividing by half the peak-to-peak range
review_preprocess_pipeline: review the preprocess_antennae_images pipeline that rotates, clips, asinh-normalizes, and renormalizes galaxy images
